newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST - Morgan Stanley raises Mexico '96 GDP view.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Morgan Stanley raises Mexico '96 GDP view.

text.p: Morgan Stanley economist Ernest Brown on Tuesday raised his 1996 gross domestic product forecast for Mexico to 4.5 percent from 4.2 percent, based on stronger-than-expected third-quarter growth.

He said his 4.0 percent 1997 forecast would stand despite the strong third-quarter performance. "Consumer demand remains weak and is weighted towards imports, and this seems likely to be a constraint on next year's growth," he said in a statement.
Mexico announced last week that its economy grew 7.4 percent in the third quarter.
